title: Most news apps are built to keep you scrolling until you are exhausted.
body:
We decided to build something different. When we started Headlinne, we realized that the problem with modern news isn't a lack of information. It is the overwhelming flood of it. Most algorithms are designed to maximize your time on screen. They prioritize outrage and breaking alerts because those things grab attention. But that approach rarely leaves you feeling informed.

Our philosophy is simple. You should control the news, not the other way around. We use AI not to feed you more content, but to filter out the noise. The goal is to give you a clear, concise summary of what matters to you personally, so you can catch up in minutes and move on with your day.

We believe intelligence in software means respecting your time. A smart news experience should be quiet, focused, and efficient. It should help you understand the world better without demanding your constant attention.
cta: If you want to see how we are rethinking the daily news habit, you can explore our approach at HEADLINNE.com.
